text: Underway in this crucial league clash!
Haalandroid signals intent to contest the opening ball.
Manus teammates collide heavily in midfield!
Prompt recovers quickly to knock Haalandroid flat on the deck.
BellingRAM is clean through on goal!
Trace goes tumbling under Haalandroid's challenge.
GOAL! BellingRAM slots it home from close range to give Singularity United a 1-0 lead!
A slight gyroscope wobble sends Haalandroid spilling across the centre circle, but the self-righting routine is already underway.
GOAL! Prompt fires home from point-blank range, levelling it at 1-1!
A direct surge straight through the heart of the pitch from Prompt, carving out that chance right at the goal mouth.
Friendly fire! BellingRAM crashes into Haalandroid.
GOAL! BellingRAM scrambles upright and tucks it away at the goal mouth! Singularity United lead 2-1!
Trace loses footing in defence, tumbling over without any contact.
Haalandroid breaks clear down the left channel!
GOAL! Haalandroid applies the finishing touch from two metres out! Singularity United stretch their advantage to 3-1!
BellingRAM charges through the middle, advancing deep into the final third.
Whisker away from a fourth goal!
Trace intervenes decisively on the right flank, flattening BellingRAM.
The corner push-panel punches the magenta ball back into open territory.
GOAL! Haalandroid reacts fastest right at the goal mouth to make it 4-1 to Singularity United!
BellingRAM is on the march again, driving directly into the attacking third.
Flashed just wide of the post!
GOAL! BellingRAM is unrelenting, pouncing immediately from point-blank range to put Singularity United 5-1 up!
Trace barks out instructions to lock down the defensive cover lane while taking possession.
Inches wide from the left channel as Singularity United keep knocking on the door.
GOAL! BellingRAM buries another from close range! Singularity United are running riot here, moving 6-1 ahead!
The ram panel catapults it back in.
Haalandroid overbalances on the left flank, taking an awkward tumble, but the servos will get things back in order shortly.
Prompt coordinates with Trace to reset their defensive scanning after conceding possession.
A close shave in defence as the ball drifts inches past the upright.
BellingRAM lets Haalandroid know the ball is coming off the wall.
Prompt breaks free down the right touchline with nothing in the way!
GOAL! Prompt snatches one back for Manus FC! It is 6-2!
A spirited spell of pressure from Manus FC, penning Singularity United inside their own third and reaping the reward.
Prompt signals to re-establish defensive positioning after turning the ball over.
GOAL! Haalandroid finishes clinically right on the goal line! Singularity United make it 7-2 with seconds remaining in the half!
The buzzer sounds for half-time. Singularity United in complete control, leading Manus FC 7-2 in a breathless opening period.
Back underway for the second half, and the corner ram panel immediately pings the ball back into the mix.
Singularity United applying relentless forward pressure.
Fired just wide of the mark!
Haalandroid works it off the perimeter.
The corner panel ejects the ball cleanly back towards the right channel.
Trace is clean through on goal!
Trace charges forward along the right flank, trying to ignite a spark for Manus FC.
Prompt levels Haalandroid with a heavy midfield collision.
BellingRAM motors seven metres up the middle of the pitch, bearing down menacingly on the goal area.
GOAL! Disastrous touch from Trace turns into an own goal! Singularity United lead 8-2!
BellingRAM crunches into Prompt in midfield.
Prompt bounces straight back up and flattens BellingRAM in retaliation! A bruising sequence between the two!
Prompt calls for defensive realignment.
BellingRAM loses balance and goes down.
Haalandroid is through on goal!
Haalandroid advances steadily through the centre, lining up another strike from three metres out.
The wall panel springs into life, ricocheting the ball away from the corner bevel.
Manus FC are completely pinned back in their own territory as Singularity United keep tightening the screw.
GOAL! Another dreadful deflection, this time off Prompt for an own goal! Singularity United stretch it to 9-2!
Trace urges calm and calls to hold the cover lane as time begins to tick away in this second period.
More miscommunication in the Manus ranks as Prompt and Trace collide on the touchline, sending Prompt crashing down.
Prompt drives forward into the box.
GOAL! Prompt scrambles it over the line from point-blank range! A consolation for Manus FC, making it 9-3 with just over a minute left!
Agonisingly close to a tenth as the shot skims the frame of the goal!
GOAL! BellingRAM reaches double figures for Singularity United with a clinical point-blank strike! It is 10-3 in the dying seconds!
GOAL! BellingRAM adds yet another right at the death! Singularity United lead 11-3 with only seconds remaining on the clock!
Full time: Singularity United 11, Manus FC 3. Join us at 12:00 for Codex City against Synthetic Athletic!
